title: [spec-gap][R-19-004/006/010/011/016/017/019-021/023/040] v0.1 screen ring (E/O tiers) entirely unimplemented
description: spec/19-device-ux.md §3/§4/§5/§6/§7/§14: the E/O display layer does not exist. No rendering code anywhere (rg display/ssd1306/eink/screen across lichen/, rust/, python/src: only HAL capability plumbing — lichen_hal_display_status/get, lichen/subsys/lichen/hal/hal_caps.c:266-269, and board display flags). Missing: ring-of-screens navigation (§4; button engine emits LICHEN_UX_BUTTON_EVT_ADVANCE with zero consumers), one-fact body + fixed status bar battery/GPS/message-waiting (§5), E partial-refresh/full-refresh-every-N policy (§6), O redraw-on-change + 60s screensaver (§6), E/O hold-feedback filling indicator ~250ms cadence (§4), three-token styling (§7), v0.1 inventory Boot→Status→Position→Last message→screensaver (§14). Data sources all exist: /status (status_cbor.c), /sensors/location (coap_location.c), /msg/inbox unread (coap_msg.c). Suggested placement: new ux screen module in lichen/subsys/lichen/ux/ (ux_screen*.c) consuming lichen_ux_button events via lichen_ux_button_start handler + lichen_hal_display_device_get; targets: t_echo (E, CONFIG_LICHEN_HAS_DISPLAY=y), heltec v3 (O, SSD1306).
